method: Independent derivation and numerical checks, separate from rendered text
claims: For a fully submerged cuboid in hydrostatic fluid, bottom-top pressure difference is rho g H, giving net force rho g H A, the weight of displaced fluid. The same-boundary fluid replacement argument generalizes to arbitrary shapes.

Floating equilibrium gives submerged volume fraction rho_body/rho_water for a uniform block. The water surface is a large-reservoir idealization; surface tension and waves are neglected. Lowering and repositioning are illustrative, not a free-motion simulation.

checks.description: Pressure difference gives displaced weight at different depths

limitations: Numerical samples verify implementation consistency, not a substitute for the stated general arguments.
